    90	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme() {
    91	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    92	
    93	  try {
    94	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    95	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    96	  } catch {}
    97	
    98	  try {
    99	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
   100	  } catch {}
   101	
   102	  try {
   103	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
   104	  } catch {}
   105	}

   107	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
   108	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   109	
   110	  useEffect(() => {
   111	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
   112	
   113	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme();
   114	
   115	    applyTheme();
   116	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
   117	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   118	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   119	      if (state === "active") {
   120	        applyTheme();
   121	      }
   122	    });
   123	    let visibilitySubscription;
   124	
   125	    try {
   126	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   127	        applyTheme,
   128	      );
   129	    } catch {}
   130	
   131	    return () => {
   132	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   133	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   134	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   135	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   136	    };
   137	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   138	
   139	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   140	    return null;
   141	  }
   142	
   143	  return (
   144	    <View
   145	      pointerEvents="none"
   146	      style={{
   147	        position: "absolute",
   148	        left: 0,
   149	        right: 0,
   150	        bottom: 0,
   151	        height: insets.bottom,
   152	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   153	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   154	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   155	        zIndex: 1000001,
   156	        elevation: 1000001,
   157	      }}
   158	    />
   159	  );
   160	}

   162	function AndroidStatusBarTint({ dimmed = false }) {
   163	  const height =
   164	    Platform.OS === "android" && Number.isFinite(StatusBar.currentHeight)
   165	      ? Math.max(0, StatusBar.currentHeight)

   169	    return null;

   171	
   172	  return (
   173	    <View

   175	      style={{
   176	        position: "absolute",

   178	        left: 0,
   179	        right: 0,

   181	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   182	        zIndex: 1000002,
   183	        elevation: 1000002,

   186	      {dimmed ? (
   187	        <View

   219	function StartupSplashArtwork({ style = null }) {
   220	  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
   221	  const iconScale = useRef(
   222	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconInitialScale),
   223	  ).current;
   224	  const iconSpin = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   225	  const iconMaskScale = useRef(
   226	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale),
   227	  ).current;
   228	  const iconSize = Math.min(
   229	    startupSplashIconMaxSize,
   230	    Math.max(startupSplashIconMinSize, width * 0.38),
   231	  );
   232	  const iconOuterRadius = iconSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   233	  const iconInnerInset = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerInsetRatio;
   234	  const iconInnerSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerSizeRatio;
   235	  const iconInnerRadius = iconInnerSize * startupSplashIconInnerRadiusRatio;
   236	  const iconBorderMaskSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconBorderMaskSizeRatio;
   237	  const iconBorderMaskOffset = (iconSize - iconBorderMaskSize) / 2;
   238	  const iconBorderMaskRadius =
   239	    iconBorderMaskSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   240	  const iconBorderMaskRotation = iconSpin.interpolate({
   241	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   242	    outputRange: ["0deg", "360deg"],
   243	  });
   244	
   245	  useEffect(() => {
   246	    const scaleAnimation = Animated.sequence([
   247	      Animated.timing(iconScale, {
   248	        toValue: startupSplashIconPeakScale,
   249	        duration: startupSplashIconEnlargeDuration,
   250	        easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
   251	        useNativeDriver: true,
   252	      }),
   253	      Animated.spring(iconScale, {
   254	        toValue: 1,
   255	        friction: 5,
   256	        tension: 90,
   257	        useNativeDriver: true,
   258	      }),
   259	    ]);
   260	    const spinAnimation = Animated.loop(
   261	      Animated.timing(iconSpin, {
   262	        toValue: 1,
   263	        duration: startupSplashIconSpinDuration,
   264	        easing: Easing.linear,
   265	        useNativeDriver: true,
   266	      }),
   267	    );
   268	    const maskPulseAnimation = Animated.loop(
   269	      Animated.sequence([
   270	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   271	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMinScale,
   272	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   273	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   274	          useNativeDriver: true,
   275	        }),
   276	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   277	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale,
   278	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   279	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   280	          useNativeDriver: true,
   281	        }),
   282	      ]),
   283	    );
   284	
   285	    scaleAnimation.start();
   286	    spinAnimation.start();
   287	    maskPulseAnimation.start();
   288	
   289	    return () => {
   290	      scaleAnimation.stop();
   291	      spinAnimation.stop();
   292	      maskPulseAnimation.stop();
   293	      iconScale.stopAnimation();
   294	      iconSpin.stopAnimation();
   295	      iconMaskScale.stopAnimation();
   296	    };
   297	  }, [iconMaskScale, iconScale, iconSpin]);
   298	
   299	  return (
   300	    <View
   301	      pointerEvents="none"
   302	      style={[
   303	        {
   304	          flex: 1,
   305	        },
   306	        style,
   307	      ]}
   308	    >
   309	      <StartupOrangeBackground
   310	        style={{
   311	          position: "absolute",
   312	          top: 0,
   313	          right: 0,
   314	          bottom: 0,
   315	          left: 0,
   316	        }}
   317	      />
   318	      <View
   319	        style={{
   320	          position: "absolute",
   321	          top: 0,
   322	          right: 0,
   323	          bottom: 0,
   324	          left: 0,
   325	          alignItems: "center",
   326	          justifyContent: "center",
   327	        }}
   328	      >
   329	        <Animated.View
   330	          style={{
   331	            height: iconSize,
   332	            transform: [{ scale: iconScale }],
   333	            width: iconSize,
   334	          }}
   335	        >
   336	          <Animated.View
   337	            pointerEvents="none"
   338	            style={{
   339	              position: "absolute",
   340	              top: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   341	              left: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   342	              height: iconBorderMaskSize,
   343	              width: iconBorderMaskSize,
   344	              backgroundColor: startupSplashIconBorderMaskCreamColor,
   345	              borderRadius: iconBorderMaskRadius,
   346	              transform: [
   347	                { rotate: iconBorderMaskRotation },
   348	                { scale: iconMaskScale },
   349	              ],
   350	            }}
   351	          />
   352	          <Image
   353	            resizeMode="stretch"
   354	            source={startupSplashIconImage}
   355	            style={{
   356	              height: iconSize,
   357	              width: iconSize,
   358	            }}
   359	          />
   360	          <View
   361	            pointerEvents="none"
   362	            style={{
   363	              position: "absolute",
   364	              top: 0,
   365	              right: 0,
   366	              bottom: 0,
   367	              left: 0,
   368	              borderRadius: iconOuterRadius,
   369	              overflow: "hidden",
   370	            }}
   371	          >
   372	            <Animated.View
   373	              style={{
   374	                position: "absolute",
   375	                top: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   376	                left: iconBorderMaskOffset,
   377	                height: iconBorderMaskSize,
   378	                width: iconBorderMaskSize,
   379	                backgroundColor: startupSplashIconBorderMaskColor,
   380	                borderRadius: iconBorderMaskRadius,
   381	                transform: [
   382	                  { rotate: iconBorderMaskRotation },
   383	                  { scale: iconMaskScale },
   384	                ],
   385	              }}
   386	            />
   387	          </View>
   388	          <View
   389	            pointerEvents="none"
   390	            style={{
   391	              position: "absolute",
   392	              top: iconInnerInset,
   393	              left: iconInnerInset,
   394	              height: iconInnerSize,
   395	              width: iconInnerSize,
   396	              borderRadius: iconInnerRadius,
   397	              overflow: "hidden",
   398	            }}
   399	          >
   400	            <Image
   401	              resizeMode="stretch"
   402	              source={startupSplashIconImage}
   403	              style={{
   404	                position: "absolute",
   405	                top: -iconInnerInset,
   406	                left: -iconInnerInset,
   407	                height: iconSize,
   408	                width: iconSize,
   409	              }}
   410	            />
   411	          </View>
   412	        </Animated.View>
   413	      </View>
   414	    </View>
   415	  );
   416	}

   497	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY, isStartupSplashReady }) {
   498	  const pathname = usePathname();
   499	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   500	  const [isStartupTutorialVisible, setIsStartupTutorialVisible] =
   501	    useState(true);
   502	  const [isStartupSplashDismissed, setIsStartupSplashDismissed] =
   503	    useState(false);
   504	  const startupTransitionProgress = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   505	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   506	  const {
   507	    cartOverlayActionRequest,
   508	    isQuestionOverlayVisible,
   509	    isShopOverlayVisible,
   510	  } = useShopCart();
   511	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   512	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   513	
   514	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   515	
   516	  const useOverlayHeader =
   517	    pathname === "/" ||
   518	    pathname === "/products" ||
   519	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   520	    pathname === "/contact";
   521	
   522	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   523	    useOverlayHeader &&
   524	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   525	  const isShopQuestionOverlayVisible =
   526	    pathname === "/shop" && isQuestionOverlayVisible;
   527	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   528	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   529	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   530	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   531	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   532	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) &&
   533	    !isShopQuestionOverlayVisible;
   534	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   535	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   536	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   537	    Platform.OS === "android" &&
   538	    ((pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) ||
   539	      isShopQuestionOverlayVisible);
   540	  const shouldShowStartupTutorial =
   541	    isStartupTutorialVisible && isStartupSplashReady;
   542	  const startupSplashOpacity = startupTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   543	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   544	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   545	  });
   546	  const handleStartupTutorialClose = useCallback(() => {
   547	    setIsStartupTutorialVisible(false);
   548	  }, []);
   549	
   550	  useEffect(() => {
   551	    if (!isStartupSplashReady || isStartupSplashDismissed) return undefined;
   552	
   553	    Animated.timing(startupTransitionProgress, {
   554	      toValue: 1,
   555	      duration: startupSplashFadeDuration,
   556	      easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic),
   557	      useNativeDriver: true,
   558	    }).start(({ finished }) => {
   559	      if (finished) {
   560	        setIsStartupSplashDismissed(true);
   561	      }
   562	    });
   563	
   564	    return () => {
   565	      startupTransitionProgress.stopAnimation();
   566	    };
   567	  }, [
   568	    isStartupSplashDismissed,
   569	    isStartupSplashReady,
   570	    startupTransitionProgress,
   571	  ]);
   572	
   573	  return (
   574	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   575	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   576	        <View
   577	          pointerEvents="none"
   578	          style={{
   579	            position: "absolute",
   580	            top: 0,
   581	            left: 0,
   582	            right: 0,
   583	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   584	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   585	          }}
   586	        >
   587	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   588	        </View>
   589	      ) : null}
   590	
   591	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   592	        <Stack
   593	          screenOptions={{
   594	            headerShown: false,
   595	            animation: "none",
   596	            contentStyle: {
   597	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   598	                ? "transparent"
   599	                : "#FFFCF2",
   600	            },
   601	          }}
   602	        />
   603	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   604	
   605	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   606	        <ScreenFade
   607	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   608	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   609	        />
   610	      ) : null}
   611	
   612	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   613	        <View
   614	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   615	          style={{
   616	            position: "absolute",
   617	            top: 0,
   618	            left: 0,
   619	            right: 0,
   620	            zIndex: 1000000,
   621	            elevation: 1000000,
   622	          }}
   623	        >
   624	          <AppHeader
   625	            dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   626	            scrollY={headerScrollY}
   627	            showHero={false}
   628	          />
   629	        </View>
   630	      ) : null}
   631	
   632	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   633	        <AppHeader
   634	          dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   635	          scrollY={headerScrollY}
   636	        />
   637	      ) : null}
   638	
   639	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   640	        <View
   641	          pointerEvents="none"
   642	          style={{
   643	            position: "absolute",
   644	            top: 0,
   645	            right: 0,
   646	            bottom: 0,
   647	            left: 0,
   648	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   649	            zIndex: 1000001,
   650	            elevation: 1000001,
   651	          }}
   652	        />
   653	      ) : null}
   654	
   655	      <StickyCartButton />
   656	
   657	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   658	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   659	      />
   660	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   661	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   662	        pathname={pathname}
   663	      />
   664	      <StartupTutorialOverlay
   665	        contentOpacity={startupTransitionProgress}
   666	        headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   667	        onClose={handleStartupTutorialClose}
   668	        visible={shouldShowStartupTutorial}
   669	      />
   670	      <StartupIconSplash
   671	        opacity={startupSplashOpacity}
   672	        visible={!isStartupSplashDismissed}
   673	      />
   674	    </View>
   675	  );
   676	}
   677	
   678	export default function RootLayout() {
   679	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   680	  const [minimumSplashElapsed, setMinimumSplashElapsed] = useState(false);
   681	
   682	  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
   683	    "Dream Avenue": require("../assets/fonts/dream_avenue/dream_avenue.ttf"),
   684	    "Great Vibes": require("../assets/fonts/great_vibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf"),
   685	    "TT Fors": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_regular.ttf"),
   686	    "TT Fors Demibold": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_demibold.ttf"),
   687	    "TT Fors Black": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_black.ttf"),
   688	    "TT Fors Light": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_light.ttf"),
   689	  });
   690	
   691	  useEffect(() => {
   692	    const minimumSplashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   693	      setMinimumSplashElapsed(true);
   694	    }, startupSplashMinimumDuration);
   695	
   696	    return () => {
   697	      clearTimeout(minimumSplashTimer);
   698	    };
   699	  }, []);
   700	
   701	  const isStartupSplashReady = fontsLoaded && minimumSplashElapsed;
   702	
   703	  if (!fontsLoaded) {
   704	    return <StartupSplashArtwork />;
   705	  }
   706	
   707	  return (
   708	    <SafeAreaProvider>
   709	      <StripeProvider
   710	        merchantIdentifier={stripeMerchantIdentifier || undefined}
   711	        publishableKey={stripePublishableKey}
   712	        setReturnUrlSchemeOnAndroid
   713	        urlScheme={stripeUrlScheme}
   714	      >
   715	        <ThemeProvider value={navigationTheme}>
   716	          <HeaderScrollProvider scrollY={headerScrollY}>
   717	            <BackgroundHeroStateProvider sourceScrollY={headerScrollY}>
   718	              <HeaderSwipeProvider>
   719	                <ShopCartProvider>
   720	                  <RootLayoutContent
   721	                    headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   722	                    isStartupSplashReady={isStartupSplashReady}
   723	                  />
   724	                </ShopCartProvider>
   725	              </HeaderSwipeProvider>
   726	            </BackgroundHeroStateProvider>
   727	          </HeaderScrollProvider>
   728	        </ThemeProvider>
   729	      </StripeProvider>
   730	    </SafeAreaProvider>
   731	  );
   732	}

    30	
    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );
    37	}
    38	
    39	export default function HomeScreen() {
    40	  const [imageLayouts, setImageLayouts] = useState({});
    41	  const [paragraphLayouts, setParagraphLayouts] = useState({});
    42	  const {
    43	    compactTopLayout,
    44	    initialContentOffset,
    45	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    46	    scrollHandlers,
    47	    scrollY,
    48	  } =
    49	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    50	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    51	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
    52	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
    53	  const croppedImageHeight = croppedImageWidth * featureImageAspectRatio;
    54	  const passionImageBlendTranslateY = scrollY.interpolate({
    55	    inputRange: [0, passionImageBlendScrollDistance],
    56	    outputRange: [-passionImageBlendFeatherHeight, croppedImageHeight],
    57	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    58	  });
    59	  const handleParagraphLayout = useCallback(
    60	    (featureName) =>
    61	      ({ nativeEvent }) => {
    62	        const { height, y } = nativeEvent.layout;
    63	        const nextLayout = { height, y };
    64	
    65	        setParagraphLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    66	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[featureName], nextLayout)) {
    67	            return currentLayouts;
    68	          }
    69	
    70	          return {
    71	            ...currentLayouts,
    72	            [featureName]: nextLayout,
    73	          };
    74	        });
    75	      },
    76	    []
    77	  );
    78	  const handleImageLayout = useCallback(
    79	    (featureName) =>
    80	      ({ nativeEvent }) => {
    81	        const { height, y } = nativeEvent.layout;
    82	        const nextLayout = { height, y };
    83	
    84	        setImageLayouts((currentLayouts) => {
    85	          if (isMatchingLayout(currentLayouts[featureName], nextLayout)) {
    86	            return currentLayouts;
    87	          }
    88	
    89	          return {
    90	            ...currentLayouts,
    91	            [featureName]: nextLayout,
    92	          };
    93	        });
    94	      },
    95	    []
    96	  );
    97	
    98	  return (
    99	    <View style={sharedStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>

   123	            magnifyExitAnchorLayout={paragraphLayouts.passion}
   124	            magnifyRampViewportRatio={homeFeatureMagnifyRampViewportRatio}
   125	            magnifiedScale={homeFeatureMagnifiedScale}
   126	            scrollY={scrollY}
   127	            style={sharedStyles.featureBlock}
   128	          >
   129	            <View
   130	              onLayout={handleImageLayout("passion")}
   131	              style={[
   132	                sharedStyles.directionalImageBlendWrap,
   133	                { width: croppedImageWidth, height: croppedImageHeight },
   134	              ]}
   135	            >
   136	              <Image
   137	                pointerEvents="none"
   138	                source={require("../passion111_mos9_bright_italian_mockup_tile_blend_both_mockup.webp")}

   171	          onLayout={onBuyButtonLayout}
   172	          onPress={onBuyPress}
   173	          style={({ pressed }) => [
   174	            productsStyles.buyButton,
   175	            pressed && productsStyles.buyButtonPressed,
   176	          ]}
   177	        >
   178	          <ProductOrangeButtonGradient />
   179	          <Text
   180	            adjustsFontSizeToFit
   181	            allowFontScaling={false}
   182	            minimumFontScale={0.72}
   183	            numberOfLines={1}
   184	            style={productsStyles.buyButtonText}
   185	          >
   186	            {`Buy ${product.title}`}
   187	          </Text>
   188	        </Pressable>
   189	      </View>
   190	    </View>
   191	  );
   192	}
   193	
   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}
   233	
   234	export default function ProductsScreen() {
   235	  const {
   236	    compactTopLayout,
   237	    initialContentOffset,
   238	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
   239	    scrollHandlers,
   240	    scrollY,
   241	  } =
   242	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
   243	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
   244	  const { width: windowWidth } = useWindowDimensions();
   245	  const croppedImageWidth = getFeatureImageWidth(windowWidth);
   246	  const openProductInShop = (productTitle) => {
   247	    router.push({
   248	      pathname: "/shop",
   249	      params: {
   250	        openProduct: String(Date.now()),
   251	        product: productTitle,
   252	      },
   253	    });
   254	  };
   255	
   256	  return (
   257	    <View style={productsStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   258	      <Animated.ScrollView
   259	        style={productsStyles.scroll}
   260	        contentContainerStyle={[
   261	          productsStyles.scrollContent,
   262	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   263	        ]}
   264	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   265	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   266	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   267	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   268	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   269	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   270	        {...scrollHandlers}
   271	      >
   272	        <View style={productsStyles.main}>
   273	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   274	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   275	            pageTitleStyle={productsStyles.pageTitle}
   276	            scrollY={scrollY}
   277	          />
   278	
   279	          {products.map((product, index) => (
   280	            <Fragment key={product.title}>
   281	              <ProductMagnifySection
   282	                croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   283	                onBuyPress={() => openProductInShop(product.title)}
   284	                product={product}
   285	                scrollY={scrollY}
   286	              />
   287	              {index < products.length - 1 ? <PageDivider /> : null}
   288	            </Fragment>
   289	          ))}
   290	        </View>
   291	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   292	    </View>
   293	  );
   294	}

    17	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {

    19	    currentLayout &&
    20	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    22	  );

FILE: mob/app/contact.js

     1	import { useRef, useState } from "react";
     2	import { Alert, Animated, Platform, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";
     3	
     4	import CenterMagnifyView from "../components/CenterMagnifyView";
     5	import HapticPressable from "../components/HapticPressable";
     6	import IOSKeyboardAccessory from "../components/IOSKeyboardAccessory";
     7	import MainScreenIntroSpacer from "../components/MainScreenIntroSpacer";
     8	import contactStyles from "../styles/contactStyles";
     9	import { sendContactMessage } from "../utils/contactMessages";
    10	import { useMainScreenScrollProps } from "../utils/mainScreenScrollContext";
    11	import { getMainScreenScrollViewProps } from "../utils/platformLayout";
    12	import { getTextInputKeyboardProps } from "../utils/textInputKeyboardProps";
    13	import useMainScreenSwipeNavigation from "../utils/useMainScreenSwipeNavigation";
    14	
    15	export default function ContactScreen() {
    16	  const contactInputRefs = useRef({});
    17	  const [name, setName] = useState("");
    18	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    19	  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
    20	  const [isPhoneInputFocused, setIsPhoneInputFocused] = useState(false);
    21	  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
    22	  const [emptyTouchedFieldKeys, setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys] = useState({});
    23	  const [blurredFieldKeys, setBlurredFieldKeys] = useState({});
    24	  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);
    25	  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState("");
    26	  const {
    27	    compactTopLayout,
    28	    initialContentOffset,
    29	    scrollContentInsetStyle,
    30	    scrollHandlers,
    31	    scrollY,
    32	  } =
    33	    useMainScreenScrollProps();
    34	  const screenSwipeHandlers = useMainScreenSwipeNavigation();
    35	  const trimmedName = name.trim();
    36	  const trimmedEmail = email.trim();
    37	  const trimmedMessage = message.trim();
    38	  const isEmailValid = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(trimmedEmail);
    39	  const canSubmit =
    40	    trimmedName.length > 0 &&
    41	    isEmailValid &&
    42	    trimmedMessage.length > 0 &&
    43	    !isSending;
    44	
    45	  const contactFieldValues = {
    46	    email,
    47	    message,
    48	    name,
    49	    phone,
    50	  };
    51	  const shouldShowFieldFault = (fieldKey) =>
    52	    Boolean(emptyTouchedFieldKeys[fieldKey]) ||
    53	    (fieldKey === "email" &&
    54	      Boolean(blurredFieldKeys.email) &&
    55	      trimmedEmail.length > 0 &&
    56	      !isEmailValid);
    57	
    58	  const focusContactField = (fieldKey) => {
    59	    contactInputRefs.current[fieldKey]?.focus?.();
    60	  };
    61	
    62	  const clearFieldFault = (fieldKey) => {
    63	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    64	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    65	        return currentFieldKeys;
    66	      }
    67	
    68	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    69	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    70	      return nextFieldKeys;
    71	    });
    72	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    73	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
    74	        return currentFieldKeys;
    75	      }
    76	
    77	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
    78	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
    79	      return nextFieldKeys;
    80	    });
    81	  };
    82	
    83	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    84	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    85	
    86	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    87	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    88	      [fieldKey]: true,
    89	    }));
    90	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    91	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    92	
    93	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    94	        return {
    95	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    96	          [fieldKey]: true,
    97	        };
    98	      }
    99	
   100	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   101	        return currentFieldKeys;
   102	      }
   103	
   104	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   105	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   106	      return nextFieldKeys;
   107	    });
   108	  };
   109	
   110	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   111	    setter(text);
   112	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   113	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   114	        return currentFieldKeys;
   115	      }
   116	
   117	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   118	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   119	      return nextFieldKeys;
   120	    });
   121	  };
   122	
   123	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   124	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   125	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   126	      return;
   127	    }
   128	
   129	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   130	  };
   131	
   132	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   133	    if (!canSubmit) {
   134	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   135	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   136	        email: true,
   137	      }));
   138	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   139	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   140	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   141	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   142	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   143	      }));
   144	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   145	      return;
   146	    }
   147	
   148	    setIsSending(true);
   149	    setStatusMessage("");
   150	
   151	    try {
   152	      await sendContactMessage({
   153	        email: trimmedEmail,
   154	        message: trimmedMessage,
   155	        name: trimmedName,
   156	        phone: phone.trim(),
   157	      });
   158	      setName("");
   159	      setEmail("");
   160	      setPhone("");
   161	      setMessage("");
   162	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   163	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   164	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   165	      showContactAlert(
   166	        "Message sent",
   167	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   168	      );
   169	    } catch (error) {
   170	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   171	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   172	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   173	    } finally {
   174	      setIsSending(false);
   175	    }
   176	  };
   177	
   178	  return (
   179	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   180	      <Animated.ScrollView
   181	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   182	        contentContainerStyle={[
   183	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   184	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   185	        ]}
   186	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   187	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   188	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   189	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   190	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   191	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   192	        {...scrollHandlers}
   193	      >
   194	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   195	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   196	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   197	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   198	            scrollY={scrollY}
   199	          />
   200	
   201	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   202	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   203	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   204	              General questions about our products?
   205	            </Text>
   206	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   207	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   208	            </Text>
   209	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   210	
   211	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   212	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   213	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   214	              <TextInput
   215	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   216	                  contactInputRefs.current.name = inputNode;
   217	                }}
   218	                style={[
   219	                  contactStyles.input,
   220	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   221	                ]}
   222	                placeholder="Your Name"
   223	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   224	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   225	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   226	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   227	                returnKeyType="next"
   228	                textContentType="name"
   229	                value={name}
   230	              />
   231	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   232	
   233	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   234	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   235	              <TextInput
   236	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   237	                  contactInputRefs.current.email = inputNode;
   238	                }}
   239	                style={[
   240	                  contactStyles.input,
   241	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   242	                ]}
   243	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   244	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   245	                keyboardType="email-address"
   246	                autoCapitalize="none"
   247	                autoCorrect={false}
   248	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   249	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   250	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   251	                }
   252	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   253	                returnKeyType="next"
   254	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   255	                value={email}
   256	              />
   257	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   258	
   259	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   260	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   261	              <TextInput

   264	                  keyboardType: "phone-pad",

   266	                style={[

   268	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   269	                ]}
   270	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   271	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   272	                onBlur={() => {
   273	                  setIsPhoneInputFocused(false);
   274	                  markFieldBlurred("phone");
   275	                }}
   276	                onChangeText={(text) =>

   300	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   301	                ]}
   302	                placeholder="Your Message"
   303	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   304	                multiline
   305	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   306	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   307	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   308	                }
   309	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   310	                returnKeyType="default"
   311	                textAlignVertical="top"
   312	                value={message}
   313	              />
   314	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   315	
   316	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY} style={contactStyles.buttonWrap}>
   317	              <HapticPressable
   318	                accessibilityRole="button"
   319	                disabled={isSending}
   320	                onPress={handleSubmit}
   321	                style={({ pressed }) => [
   322	                  contactStyles.button,
   323	                  (!canSubmit || pressed) && contactStyles.buttonDimmed,
   324	                ]}
   325	              >
   326	                <Text style={contactStyles.buttonText}>
   327	                  {isSending ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
   328	                </Text>
   329	              </HapticPressable>
   330	              {statusMessage ? (
   331	                <Text style={contactStyles.statusText}>{statusMessage}</Text>
   332	              ) : null}
   333	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   334	          </View>
   335	        </View>
   336	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   337	      <IOSKeyboardAccessory
   338	        onNext={() => focusContactField("message")}
   339	        onPrevious={() => focusContactField("email")}
   340	        visible={Platform.OS === "ios" && isPhoneInputFocused}
   341	      />
   342	    </View>
   343	  );
   344	}

   626	  if (normalizedZip.length !== 5) {
   627	    return false;
   628	  }
   629	
   630	  if (deliveryServiceAreaZipCodes.has(normalizedZip)) {
   631	    return true;
   632	  }
   633	
   634	  const numericZip = Number(normalizedZip);
   635	
   636	  return deliveryServiceAreaZipRanges.some(
   637	    ([startZip, endZip]) => numericZip >= startZip && numericZip <= endZip,
   638	  );
   639	};

   782	function getStripeCardBrandLabel(brand) {
   783	  switch (brand) {
   784	    case "Visa":
   785	      return "VISA";
   786	    case "MasterCard":
   787	      return "MASTERCARD";
   788	    case "AmericanExpress":
   789	      return "AMEX";
   790	    case "Unknown":
   791	    case undefined:
   792	    case null:
   793	      return "";
   794	    default:
   795	      return String(brand)
   796	        .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
   797	        .toUpperCase();
   798	  }
   799	}

   801	const normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits = (text, maxLength) =>
   802	  String(text || "")
   803	    .replace(/\D/g, "")
   804	    .slice(0, maxLength);
   805	
   806	function formatPaymentCardFallbackValue(fieldKey, text) {
   807	  if (fieldKey === "number") {
   808	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 19)
   809	      .replace(/(.{4})/g, "$1 ")
   810	      .trim();
   811	  }
   812	
   813	  if (fieldKey === "expiration") {
   814	    const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   815	
   816	    return digits.length > 2
   817	      ? `${digits.slice(0, 2)}/${digits.slice(2)}`
   818	      : digits;
   819	  }
   820	
   821	  if (fieldKey === "cvc") {
   822	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   823	  }
   824	
   825	  if (fieldKey === "postalCode") {
   826	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 5);
   827	  }
   828	
   829	  return text;
   830	}
   831	
   832	function getPaymentCardFallbackStripeBrand(number) {
   833	  const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(number, 19);
   834	  const firstTwoDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 2));
   835	  const firstFourDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 4));
   836	
   837	  if (digits.startsWith("4")) {
   838	    return "Visa";
   839	  }
   840	
   841	  if (digits.startsWith("34") || digits.startsWith("37")) {
   842	    return "AmericanExpress";
   843	  }
   844	
   845	  if (
   846	    (firstTwoDigits >= 51 && firstTwoDigits <= 55) ||
   847	    (firstFourDigits >= 2221 && firstFourDigits <= 2720)
   848	  ) {
   849	    return "MasterCard";
   850	  }
   851	
   852	  return "Unknown";
   853	}

   855	function getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values) {
   856	  return {
   857	    cvc: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.cvc, 4),
   858	    expiration: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.expiration, 4),
   859	    number: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.number, 19),
   860	    postalCode: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.postalCode, 5),
   861	  };
   862	}

   864	function isPaymentCardFallbackComplete(values) {
   865	  const normalizedValues = getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values);
   866	  const expirationMonth = Number(normalizedValues.expiration.slice(0, 2));
   867	
   868	  return (
   869	    normalizedValues.number.length >= 12 &&
   870	    normalizedValues.expiration.length === 4 &&
   871	    expirationMonth >= 1 &&
   872	    expirationMonth <= 12 &&
   873	    normalizedValues.cvc.length >= 3 &&
   874	    normalizedValues.postalCode.length >= 5
   875	  );
   876	}

  1106	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {
  1107	  const strokeInset = piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth / 2;
  1108	  const strokeColor = muted ? "#888888" : "#111111";
  1109	  const isUpTriangle = direction === "up";
  1110	  const fillGradientId = isUpTriangle
  1111	    ? "piccolaQuantityTriangleTopGradient"
  1112	    : "piccolaQuantityTriangleBottomGradient";
  1113	  const fillGradientColors = isUpTriangle
  1114	    ? topOverlayGradientColors
  1115	    : orangeButtonGradientColors;
  1116	  const path =
  1117	    isUpTriangle
  1118	      ? [
  1119	          `M ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${strokeInset}`,
  1120	          `L ${
  1121	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
  1122	          } ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset}`,
  1123	          `L ${strokeInset} ${
  1124	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
  1125	          }`,
  1126	          "Z",
  1127	        ].join(" ")
  1128	      : [
  1129	          `M ${strokeInset} ${strokeInset}`,
  1130	          `L ${
  1131	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
  1132	          } ${strokeInset}`,
  1133	          `L ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${
  1134	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
  1135	          }`,
  1136	          "Z",
  1137	        ].join(" ");
  1138	
  1139	  return (
  1140	    <Svg
  1141	      height="100%"
  1142	      style={shopStyles.piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleSvg}
  1143	      viewBox={`0 0 ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth} ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}`}
  1144	      width="100%"
  1145	    >
  1146	      <Defs>
  1147	        <SvgLinearGradient
  1148	          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
  1149	          id={fillGradientId}
  1150	          x1={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
  1151	          x2={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
  1152	          y1={isUpTriangle ? piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight : 0}
  1153	          y2={isUpTriangle ? 0 : piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}
  1154	        >
  1155	          {fillGradientColors.map((color, index) => (
  1156	            <Stop
  1157	              key={`${fillGradientId}-${color}`}
  1158	              offset={`${index * 50}%`}
  1159	              stopColor={color}
  1160	            />
  1161	          ))}
  1162	        </SvgLinearGradient>
  1163	      </Defs>
  1164	      <Path
  1165	        d={path}
  1166	        fill={`url(#${fillGradientId})`}

  2302	    const nextLoopedIndex = Math.min(
  2303	      deliveryTimeWheelLoopCount * options.length - 1,
  2304	      Math.max(0, currentLoopedIndex + direction),
  2305	    );
  2306	    const nextIndex =
  2307	      ((nextLoopedIndex % options.length) + options.length) % options.length;
  2308	
  2309	    if (Platform.OS === "ios") {
  2310	      deliveryTimeWheelProgrammaticBlockedUntilRef.current[fieldKey] =
  2311	        Date.now() + 500;
  2312	    }
  2313	
  2314	    deliveryTimeWheelIsDraggingRef.current[fieldKey] = false;
  2315	    setDeliveryFieldValues((currentValues) => ({
  2316	      ...currentValues,
  2317	      [fieldKey]: options[nextIndex],
  2318	    }));
  2319	    setActiveDeliveryFieldKey(fieldKey);
  2320	    setIsDeliveryCityDropdownOpen(false);
  2321	    setIsDeliveryStateDropdownOpen(false);
  2322	    setOpenDeliveryTimeDropdownKey(null);
  2323	    setIsPaymentIssuerDropdownOpen(false);
  2324	    setDeliveryTimeWheelVisibleLoopedIndex(fieldKey, nextLoopedIndex);
  2325	    scrollDeliveryTimeWheelToLoopedIndex(
  2326	      fieldKey,
  2327	      nextLoopedIndex,
  2328	      Platform.OS !== "ios",
  2329	    );
  2330	  };

  2332	  const beginDeliveryTimeWheelSwipe = (fieldKey, pageY) => {
  2333	    deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey] = pageY;
  2334	    deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey] = pageY;
  2335	    setActiveDeliveryFieldKey(fieldKey);
  2336	    setIsDeliveryCityDropdownOpen(false);
  2337	    setIsDeliveryStateDropdownOpen(false);
  2338	    setOpenDeliveryTimeDropdownKey(null);

  2344	  };
  2345	
  2346	  const releaseDeliveryTimeWheelSwipe = (fieldKey, options, pageY) => {
  2347	    const startY = deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2348	    const endY = Number.isFinite(pageY)
  2349	      ? pageY
  2350	      : deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2351	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2352	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2353	
  2354	    if (!Number.isFinite(startY) || !Number.isFinite(endY)) {
  2355	      return;
  2356	    }
  2357	
  2358	    const deltaY = endY - startY;
  2359	
  2360	    if (Math.abs(deltaY) < deliveryTimeWheelSwipeThreshold) {
  2361	      return;
  2362	    }
  2363	
  2364	    const stepCount = Math.max(
  2365	      1,
  2366	      Math.min(3, Math.round(Math.abs(deltaY) / 28)),
  2367	    );
  2368	    stepDeliveryTimeWheelValue(
  2369	      fieldKey,
  2370	      options,
  2371	      deltaY < 0 ? stepCount : -stepCount,
  2372	    );
  2373	  };

  3071	  const handleOverlayBandTouchMove = (event) => {
  3072	    if (overlaySwipeCommittedRef.current) return;
  3073	
  3074	    const startX = overlaySwipeStartXRef.current;
  3075	    const startY = overlaySwipeStartYRef.current;
  3076	    const { x: currentX, y: currentY } = getOverlayBandTouchPoint(event);
  3077	
  3078	    if (
  3079	      typeof startX !== "number" ||
  3080	      typeof startY !== "number" ||
  3081	      typeof currentX !== "number" ||
  3082	      typeof currentY !== "number"
  3083	    ) {
  3084	      return;
  3085	    }
  3086	
  3087	    const dx = currentX - startX;
  3088	    const dy = Math.abs(currentY - startY);
  3089	    const minimumHorizontalSwipeDistance = 12.5;
  3090	    const horizontalDominanceRatio = 0.4375;
  3091	    const isHorizontalSwipeIntent =
  3092	      Math.abs(dx) >= minimumHorizontalSwipeDistance &&
  3093	      Math.abs(dx) > dy * horizontalDominanceRatio;
  3094	
  3095	    if (!isHorizontalSwipeIntent) return;
  3096	
  3097	    overlaySwipeCommittedRef.current = true;
  3098	
  3099	    if (dx < 0) {
  3100	      goToOverlayNextProduct();
  3101	    } else {
  3102	      goToOverlayPreviousProduct();
  3103	    }
  3104	  };
